releaseNotes:
• Precision Malayalam TMDB Match Engine: Eliminates false Hollywood matches (e.g. Patriot now correctly matches Malayalam film starring Mammootty, Mohanlal, Fahadh Faasil instead of 2000 Mel Gibson movie)
• Complete IPTV Prefix & Suffix Stripping: Removes SIN -, MAL -, ML -, IND -, [Malayalam], [1080p], resolving loading stalls for CBI 5: The Brain and hundreds of movies
• Malayalam Language Boost & Pagination: Smart +160 language weighting and multi-page search fallback for regional titles
• Full TV Remote D-Pad Navigation in Movie Details: Seamless browsing across Cast cards with Enter/OK to search actor filmographies
• Universal Enter/OK activation for all search and library movie cards
